subject.title: Feature proposal: codexbar guard — a quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar own a stable quota-gating command, and if so should the MVP be limited to a raw remaining-percent threshold without projection or reset policy?
rationale: The underlying data path is established, but the command would create a new automation contract and VISION.md requires sign-off for new features; source inspection cannot determine the intended policy or whether existing exit-code meanings may change.

options.title: Sponsor percent-only MVP
options.body: Add a single-provider `guard --need` evaluator with JSON output, a distinct insufficient-headroom result, and existing operational errors left unchanged.

options.title: Keep policy external
options.body: Document a `codexbar usage --format json` shell example and let each caller define its own threshold and failure policy.

options.title: Design full policy first
options.body: Specify multi-window, reset, duration, unknown-data, and multi-provider semantics before accepting implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor percent-only MVP
recommendation.body: Add a single-provider `guard --need` evaluator with JSON output, a distinct insufficient-headroom result, and existing operational errors left unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the explicit addressee, owns the documented product direction, and has the strongest recent history across the CLI and quota surfaces.
